scope: Selections for unchanged programs/run.py; this is not a new catalog or timing protocol. Budgets are nominal presets, not completion guarantees. Actual private-path activation is a separate semantic gate.

reject3.purpose: Initial affected-path, fixed-entry and public fallback rejection screen.

fast5.purpose: Historical five canaries; insufficient alone for private composition.

core8.purpose: Default candidate screen: all five canaries plus positive private-tree composition, arithmetic and immutable results.

worst6.purpose: Six largest remaining Phase47 array06/TypeScript ratios; targeted development evidence, not a representative aggregate.

worst-extra3.purpose: After core8, add only the three missing worst-six cases to avoid duplicate samples.

finalProtocol.scope: One final selected compiler; reuse original rounds/warmups and expensive-raytrace policy. Intermediate hypotheses get focused checks and screens first.
